command: set -e; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android; SDK="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties; cd apps/mobile/android; ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug >/tmp/lcl-v5-gradle.log 2>&1; tail -25 /tmp/lcl-v5-gradle.log
